title: Japan Corporate Goods Price Index (November 2026) — the BoJ's own producer-price print, four days before its December Tankan
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/statistics/outline/tkohyos.xlsx ('Schedule for Releases of Statistical Data (From July 2026 to June 2027)', linked from boj.or.jp/en/statistics/outline/), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 48,500 bytes), unzipped and parsed cell-by-cell out of its 'Statistics data' sheet by this session. Section '9. Price Index' row 237 labels the Corporate Goods Price Index as monthly at '8:50 a.m.' with column J reading '(For Nov.)', and row 238 gives that column's date as Excel serial 46366 = 2026-12-10; the same row's serial 46213 = 2026-07-10 for '(For June)' sits in the already-elapsed part of the schedule, and the adjacent Tankan rows on the same sheet decode against an observed release (row 231's June-survey serial 46204 = 2026-07-01 matches the Bank's published 'July 1, 2026 | June 2026 Survey' archive entry), so the serial decoding is validated rather than assumed. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the fourteen Bank of Japan entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-tankan-2026-12-14 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), off the same BoJ release-schedule sheet that fixes the December Tankan. Tracked for three reasons, none of them tradeable. FIRST, it is the Bank's own producer-price series — Japan's PPI analogue — published by the same institution, at the same 08:50 JST minute, four days before the December Tankan whose price-expectations tables it contextualises and eight days before the December MPM decision (boj-decision-2026-12-18, estimate). SECOND, it lands on 2026-12-10, which already carries the US CPI print (cpi-2026-12-10, confirmed, high) and sits one day after the FOMC (fomc-2026-12-09, confirmed, high): the 12-10 Tokyo session is therefore the first Japanese bar after the Fed, and any attempt to read a Japanese price print off that tape has to clear the FOMC first. THIRD, it is the missing member of a set this calendar already tracks in full on the US side — ppi-2026-12-15 (US PPI) and japan-cpi-2026-12-18 (Japan national CPI) are both entries, while Japan's producer-price print was not. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and this calendar measures no channel from Japanese macro prints to the Nikkei open, the S&P or the yen (the December-Tankan cuts in docs/research/events/boj-tankan-2026-12-14.md run 0.94x, 1.12x and 1.33x respectively, none significant). Precedent for filing a non-MPM Bank of Japan statistical release as its own entry: japan-cpi-2026-12-18 and boj-tankan-2026-12-14, both kind 'macro-print'. Release time is read directly off the schedule sheet ('8:50 a.m.') and is asserted only at that source's strength.
